page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.6xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz on x86_64 architecture. Managed via the KVM hypervisor, it provides 24 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of memory, establishing a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU for balanced resource allocation.

The hardware profile includes an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth capacity. It features zero local disk storage and contains no discrete GPU hardware acceleration, requiring all persistent storage needs to be served by attached cloud block volumes.

Without local storage or specialized accelerators, the instance offers a uniform baseline for general computing workloads. It is suitable for hosting enterprise applications, web application servers, containerized workloads, microservices, and medium-scale database nodes.
